name: RP-1 kerosene
why: Dense hydrocarbon fuel for first stages (Merlin)

name: Liquid oxygen
why: Oxidiser that is the largest share of chemical propellant mass

name: Liquid hydrogen
why: Highest-Isp chemical fuel and the working fluid of nuclear thermal rockets

name: Liquid methane
why: Storable-cryogenic fuel producible on Mars (Raptor, BE-4)

name: Hydrazine
why: Monopropellant for attitude and station-keeping thrusters

name: Monomethylhydrazine
why: Hypergolic fuel for long-storable bipropellant thrusters

name: AF-M315E / ASCENT green monopropellant
why: Less toxic, denser hydrazine replacement flown on NASA GPIM

name: Antihydrogen (antimatter)
why: Highest energy density possible; produced only in atoms-scale amounts

name: Metastable metallic hydrogen (hypothetical)
why: Proposed propellant of theoretical Isp about 1700 s if metastable; unconfirmed
